doneCriteria: Project dependencies available in isolated worktree

tasks.title: Preflight repo snapshot
doneCriteria: Snapshot commands complete
Branch/worktree state captured in report

commands: npx eslint src functions workers tests scripts --ext .ts,.tsx,.js,.mjs,.cjs
doneCriteria: All commands attempted
Pass/fail and durations recorded

doneCriteria: Current failure signatures summarized

tasks.title: Dependency audit snapshot
doneCriteria: Audit vulnerabilities captured

doneCriteria: Chunk warnings and largest assets visible in report

tasks.title: Manifest orphaned assets report
doneCriteria: Orphaned and missing asset counts captured

tasks.title: Lint debt hotspot report
commands: set -o pipefail; npx eslint src functions workers tests scripts --ext .ts,.tsx,.js,.mjs,.cjs -f json | node scripts/nightshift-lint-hotspots.mjs || true
doneCriteria: Top warning/error files identified

tasks.title: GitHub issues snapshot (optional if gh is installed)
commands: gh issue list --limit 20 || echo 'gh CLI unavailable or unauthenticated'
doneCriteria: Issue snapshot recorded or availability noted

doneCriteria: Some failing tests reduced with targeted verification

tasks.title: Add scoped lint commands for night runs
commands: codex --task 'Add scoped lint scripts (app/functions/workers/scripts) for predictable automation and update docs'
doneCriteria: New lint scripts run successfully

tasks.title: Block production Playwright baseURL for unattended runs
commands: codex --task 'Add a safe guard so unattended night runs cannot default Playwright to https://wojak.ink without explicit override'
doneCriteria: Unattended mode refuses production baseURL

tasks.title: Analyze and optimize large chunks (>600kB)
commands: codex --task 'Analyze the 600kB+ chunks (index-C3DoTY4g.js, vendor-wallet-CDY4elrJ.js). Review vite.config for manual chunk splits. Suggest and implement safe code-splitting strategy to reduce chunk sizes. Validate with npm run build. Commit if improvement achieved.'
doneCriteria: Chunks analyzed, strategy implemented or documented

tasks.title: Identify and remove dead code / unused dependencies
commands: codex --task 'Use npx depcheck and manual review to find unused dependencies and dead code. Remove safe, unused imports/functions. Run tests and build to validate. Commit safe removals only.'
doneCriteria: At least one unused dependency or dead code block removed

tasks.title: Identify and close critical test coverage gaps
commands: codex --task 'Run npm run test:coverage (if available) or vitest --coverage. Identify critical untested functions in src/pages, src/services, functions/api. Write targeted tests for 2-3 high-impact gaps. Validate coverage improves. Commit tests.'
expectedOutputs: new test files or test additions
doneCriteria: Coverage report generated, tests added for high-impact gaps

tasks.title: Profile and optimize slow components
commands: codex --task 'Review src/pages for performance bottlenecks (useMemo/useCallback misses, unnecessary re-renders). Profile FightClub voting, gallery listing, and arcade games. Add memoization where safe. Validate with build and unit tests. Commit optimizations.'
doneCriteria: At least 2-3 performance improvements identified and implemented

tasks.title: Update docs and generate nightshift summary
commands: codex --task 'Review docs/ folder. Update CLAUDE.md, PROJECT_DOCUMENTATION.md with latest nightshift findings. Create docs/NIGHTSHIFT-GUIDE.md explaining nightly automation. Generate final summary of all changes and recommendations.'
doneCriteria: Docs updated, final summary generated

tasks.title: Implement progressive image loading and lazy-loading
commands: codex --task 'Add progressive image loading (blur→full) to Gallery, Rankings, NFTCard components. Implement loading="lazy" on all image components. Add WebP with PNG fallback. Cache IPFS URLs in localStorage with 24h TTL. Run tests and build. Commit optimizations.'
expectedOutputs: git diff with image optimization changes
doneCriteria: Progressive loading + lazy-loading implemented and tested

tasks.title: Add skeleton loaders to high-traffic pages
commands: codex --task 'Create SkeletonCard, SkeletonRanking, SkeletonVoteCard components. Add skeleton loaders to Gallery, Rankings, and FightClub pages. Implement progressive reveal (headers first, then content). Run tests. Commit UX improvements.'
doneCriteria: Skeleton loaders added to at least 3 pages

tasks.title: Implement smart API caching and request deduplication
commands: codex --task 'Create useCachedFetch hook with TTL-based caching (60-300s). Implement in-flight request deduplication. Add localStorage fallback for offline. Update Gallery, Rankings, FightClub to use useCachedFetch. Run tests and build. Commit hook and integrations.'
doneCriteria: Hook implemented and integrated into 3+ pages

tasks.title: Add robust error handling and retry logic
commands: codex --task 'Add inline error components with Retry buttons to Gallery, FightClub, Rankings. Implement exponential backoff for failed votes. Add toast notifications for success/error. Update IPFS fallback CDN visibility. Run tests. Commit error improvements.'
doneCriteria: Error recovery implemented on 2+ critical pages

tasks.title: Polish mobile UX (touch targets, layout, responsive)
commands: codex --task 'Audit FightClub vote card on mobile (<600px). Increase button tap zones to 44px minimum. Reorganize vote card layout (vertical on mobile, horizontal on desktop). Stack rankings list appropriately. Test on multiple breakpoints. Commit mobile improvements.'
expectedOutputs: git diff with mobile CSS/layout changes
doneCriteria: Mobile FightClub and Rankings polished and tested

tasks.title: Add entrance animations and micro-interactions
commands: codex --task 'Add entrance animations (fade-in, slide-up) to pages. Add vote feedback animations (scale pulse on vote submit). Add score tick animations. Create custom Wojak spinner. Add hover effects (card lift, button glow). Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Update src/styles/animations.css. Commit animations.'
doneCriteria: At least 5 animations implemented and working

tasks.title: Accessibility audit and remediation (A11y)
commands: codex --task 'Run a11y checks: add aria-labels to all icon buttons, verify tab order, check color contrast (≥4.5:1 for text). Fix keyboard nav issues. Associate form labels with inputs. Use axe DevTools checks as reference. Commit a11y fixes.'
doneCriteria: At least 10 a11y issues identified and fixed

tasks.title: CSS consolidation and theme.css optimization
commands: codex --task 'Audit components for inline styles or scattered CSS. Consolidate all visual styles into src/styles/theme.css. Remove !important rules. Use CSS variables consistently. Ensure Tailwind is layout-only (no colors/sizing overrides). Validate build. Commit CSS cleanup.'
doneCriteria: All visual styles consolidated to theme.css

tasks.title: Audit and enable stricter TypeScript checks
commands: codex --task 'Review tsconfig.json. Enable stricter flags (noImplicitAny, exactOptionalPropertyTypes if safe). Identify breaking changes. Fix type issues incrementally. Validate tests and build. Commit TS improvements.'
doneCriteria: Stricter TS checks validated without breaking builds

tasks.title: Clean up branch history and prepare final PR
commands: codex --task 'Review all commits on nightly branch. Ensure commit messages are clear and atomic. Prepare PR description with summary of all changes, impact metrics, and testing notes. Create nightshift-FINAL-SUMMARY.md with all achievements.'
doneCriteria: Branch is clean and ready for review/merge

tasks.title: Final full validation (build, tests, lint, type-check)
commands: npx eslint src functions workers tests scripts --ext .ts,.tsx,.js,.mjs,.cjs
doneCriteria: All checks pass, no errors or warnings

tasks.title: Generate next-night queue proposals from findings
commands: echo 'Queue expansion is derived from current run findings and listed in the summary report'
doneCriteria: Next-night tasks listed in report
